summary: license_checker.sh is well-written with proper set -euo pipefail, error handling, and modular functions. However, run_act_tests.sh line 8 has `set -uo pipefail` (missing 'e') — violates best practice and makes test failures silently pass. File ops (cp, git init) at lines 54-59 lack error handling. Workflow lacks actionlint validation step and bats version pinning. Manifest-finding logic (lines 38-42) is verbose. Core functionality is solid; test harness fragility prevents shipping without fixes.
